$comment: GIS libraries for Windows builds (vcpkg manifest mode). Linux uses the distribution packages (libgdal-dev, libproj-dev). Only the parts GeoMap AI needs: GeoTIFF/COG, GeoJSON, GeoPackage (sqlite3), KML (expat), JPEG/PNG inside TIFF; no network access, no GEOS. See docs/DEPENDENCIES.md. The application version is in CMakeLists.txt (not here, so that a new version does not invalidate the CI package cache).
name: geomap-ai
